scope: Ukraine medical discovery — Bogomolets National Medical University

verifiedFacts.claim: NMU's 2026 foreign-citizen admission notice sets Medicine at six years, says teaching is in Ukrainian or English, and permits face-to-face and/or remote admission and study.
The same NMU notice gives 19 July–31 October 2026 as its foreign first-course application and enrolment period.
Ukraine's official Study in Ukraine portal lists NMU as state-owned and lists English-medium Medicine at USD 3,500 for first year.
Ukraine's Ministry of Education states that foreign applicants use the Unified State System for Foreigners' Admission and that universities determine autumn and winter international intakes.

holdReasons: The official 2026 admission notice permits face-to-face and/or remote study, but does not identify the delivery mode, clinical-practice arrangements or contingency terms for the international English Medicine cohort.
The available official fee portal does not state the academic year or mandatory charges for its USD 3,500 English-Medicine figure; it cannot be treated as a current fee without confirmation.
No independent current programme-accreditation/recognition record sufficient for the required recognition badges was established in this batch.

Ukraine's Ministry reports continuing war-related higher-education infrastructure damage and disruption. A programme page needs institution-specific safety and continuity evidence rather than a generic country assurance.
nextAction: Obtain a 2026/27 NMU offer/fee notice that fixes the English cohort's fee, location/delivery mode, clinical training and continuity arrangements, plus current independent recognition evidence.
